preset.reference_title: EuroHPC JU Call for Proposals - Regular Access Mode
preset.summary: Allocations for scientific, industry and public administration applicants, peer reviewed after each cut-off.

call.name: Regular Access
call.description: Access to the peta-scale and pre-exascale systems for scientific, industry and public administration applicants. Proposals are evaluated together after each cut-off: administrative check, technical assessment per partition, two rapporteurs assigned by the Domain Panel Chair, the Domain Panel and Super Panel meetings, and the final feedback before the allocation decision.

panels.name: Universe Sciences and Fundamental Constituents of Matter
panels.description: Domain Panel for astrophysics, cosmology, particle, nuclear and plasma physics.

panels.name: Chemical Sciences and Materials
panels.description: Domain Panel for chemistry, materials science, nanoscience and condensed matter.

panels.name: Earth System Sciences
panels.description: Domain Panel for geoscience, climate, weather and the environment.

panels.name: Life Sciences and Medicine
panels.description: Domain Panel for biology, biophysics, bioinformatics, biomedicine and neuroscience.

panels.name: Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science
panels.description: Domain Panel for fluid dynamics, engineering, applied mathematics, computer science and other domains.

proposal_roles.name: Domain Panel Chair
proposal_roles.description: The chair of the Domain Panel the proposal is routed to, assigned when the Domain Panel Chair assignment starts. Assigns the rapporteurs, reports the panel's meeting outcome and writes the final feedback.

proposal_roles.name: Rapporteur
proposal_roles.description: A member of the proposal's Domain Panel who evaluates it. Each proposal has two: the Lead Rapporteur, marked as the lead, and the Second Rapporteur.

workflow_steps.name: Administrative check
workflow_steps.description: The call managers check the submission form and the Project Scope and Plan document for administrative inconsistencies. A rejected proposal stops here and may be resubmitted to a later cut-off.

workflow_steps.name: Technical assessment
workflow_steps.description: The team of each requested partition assesses whether the proposal can run there: accepted, conditionally accepted or rejected. A rejected partition does not stop the proposal.

workflow_steps.name: Domain Panel Chair assignment
workflow_steps.description: Alongside the technical assessment, the proposal goes to the Domain Panel covering its research domain and that panel's chair is assigned as its Domain Panel Chair, who confirms having no conflict of interest. The Access Resource Committee chair or vice-chair checks the routing, moves the proposal to another panel when its topic calls for it, and completes the step.

workflow_steps.name: Rapporteur assignment
workflow_steps.description: The Domain Panel Chair assigns two panel members as the proposal's rapporteurs, one of them marked as the Lead Rapporteur. Each confirms having no conflict of interest.

workflow_steps.name: Individual reports
workflow_steps.description: Each rapporteur writes an individual report scoring the proposal on excellence, innovation and impact, and quality and efficiency of the implementation. The call managers then open the Domain Panel meeting.

criteria.name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

workflow_steps.name: Domain Panel meeting
workflow_steps.description: Run once per round: the call managers open it for the round once the round's proposals have reached it. Each Domain Panel Chair then writes one round report for the panel's meeting, covering the proposals of the domain, and ranks them there with their consolidated score and a resource recommendation. A proposal moves on once every report covering it is submitted.

workflow_steps.name: Consolidated report
workflow_steps.description: The Domain Panel Chair writes the consolidated report from the individual reports and the Domain Panel meeting outcome, or hands it to one of the rapporteurs to write. The call managers then open the Super Panel meeting.

workflow_steps.name: Super Panel meeting
workflow_steps.description: Run once per round: the call managers open it for the round once the round's proposals have reached it. The Access Resource Committee discusses all proposals of the cut-off together, irrespective of domain. Its chair and vice-chair each write a round report covering every proposal, and the overall ranking of the round -- final score and resource recommendation per proposal -- is recorded on the round. The step completes once both reports are submitted; the call managers then open the final feedback.

workflow_steps.name: Final feedback
workflow_steps.description: The Domain Panel Chair writes the feedback for the applicant after the Super Panel meeting. Once released, the applicant reads it with the allocation decision.

workflow_steps.name: Resource allocation decision
workflow_steps.description: The Resource Allocation Panel allocates resources following the Super Panel's ranking and recommendations, and the call managers record each proposal's result. The Governing Board then adopts the list on the round, before its results are published.

workflow_steps.name: Award response
workflow_steps.description: The applicant accepts or declines the award before resources are created.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request
workflow_steps.description: An awarded applicant asks to extend the project: the circumstances and the resource usage so far, the new end date and the resources needed. Asked at the latest one month before the project ends.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request assessment
workflow_steps.description: The team of each partition hosting the project assesses whether the extension is valid and can be accepted: accepted, conditionally accepted or rejected. Only a partition whose team accepts takes the extension.

workflow_steps.name: Extension request results
workflow_steps.description: The call managers decide the extension following the assessment: the end date and resources granted. An approved extension moves the project's end date; more resources are ordered from the partitions, whose providers approve the orders as usual.

workflow_steps.name: Final report
workflow_steps.description: The awarded applicant submits the project's final report. The step opens at the end of the allocation period, an extension included.

workflow_steps.name: Final report approval
workflow_steps.description: The call managers approve the final report, which completes the project.

checklists.name: Individual report
checklists.description: A rapporteur's own assessment and scores of the proposal.

questions.user_guidance: Assess the proposal against the three criteria, taking the technical assessment into account.

questions.description: Score: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

checklists.name: Domain Panel meeting report
checklists.description: The Domain Panel's meeting for its proposals of the cut-off. Each proposal's consolidated score, rank within the domain and resource recommendation are entered in the report's ranking.

questions.user_guidance: The panel's discussion of its proposals at the meeting.

checklists.name: Consolidated report
checklists.description: The rapporteurs' consolidated report, written after the Domain Panel meeting.

questions.user_guidance: Consolidate the individual reports and the Domain Panel meeting outcome into one report.

checklists.name: Super Panel meeting report
checklists.description: The Access Resource Committee's meeting for the proposals of the cut-off. The final scores, overall rank and recommendations are entered in the round's ranking.

questions.user_guidance: The committee's discussion of the proposals at the Super Panel meeting.

checklists.name: Final feedback
checklists.description: The feedback the applicant reads once it is released.

questions.user_guidance: Summarise the evaluation for the applicant. The applicant reads this text once the feedback is released.

checklists.name: Extension request
checklists.description: Why an awarded project needs more time or resources.

questions.user_guidance: Describe what happened that calls for an extension, and what the extension lets the project finish.
Summarise how the allocated resources have been used up to now on each partition.

checklists.name: Final report
checklists.description: The results of an awarded project once its allocation ends.

questions.user_guidance: Report what the project achieved with the allocated resources, including publications and outcomes.
Optional. One PDF file with the full report.

scenarios.name: Happy path
scenarios.description: Every step passes and the applicant accepts the award.

scenarios.name: Rejected at the administrative check
scenarios.description: The office finds the proposal ineligible: it is rejected, the applicant is told and no other step runs.

scenarios.name: Changes requested at the administrative check
scenarios.description: The office asks for changes, the applicant submits them and the proposal is then found eligible; the technical assessment starts together with the Domain Panel Chair assignment.

actions.message: Please complete the Project Scope and Plan.

scenarios.name: Extension and final report
scenarios.description: After the award the applicant team asks for an extension, the partitions accept it and it is approved; at the end the final report is submitted and approved.

scenarios.name: Not awarded
scenarios.description: The Resource Allocation Panel does not award the proposal: it is rejected and the applicant is told; no award response is asked.
